## PRB1.7. Investments {#prb1.7.-investments .Heading-2-ER}

- NAVIAIR planned a total asset value for new investments in RP4 of 122.0M€2022, of which 47.1% relates to new major investments. NAVIAIR planned 7 new major investments for RP4, of which 6 have started and 1 has not yet started.

- In 2025, NAVIAIR underspent -0.04M€2022 (-8.4%) in costs related to new major investments. This is mainly attributable to the COOPANS Legacy project.

- According to the reporting tables, NAVIAIR overspent +0.7M€2022 (+3.6%) in costs related to investments in 2025.

- NAVIAIR reported 0.03M€2022 in funding from Union assistance programmes in 2025.
